patterns.note: A stark, high-contrast monochrome palette dominates, using pure black for the background and pure white for all primary text and graphic elements.
All text on the page utilizes a single, distinct display font, with the main 'ENTER' call-to-action featuring a larger size and a subtle outline effect.

The page features continuous, non-scroll-triggered animation of a central skeletal ouroboros graphic and subtle background particles, creating a dynamic yet static entry point. The 'ENTER' text also exhibits a glitch-like character scramble before settling.
The design is a single, full-screen, centrally-aligned interactive gateway, devoid of traditional navigation or content sections, focusing entirely on the central graphic and call-to-action.

technique_notes: The entire page is a single, non-scrolling view. A canvas element is used to render a continuously animating particle effect in the background, giving a subtle sense of depth and movement.
A central graphic, likely rendered via canvas or SVG, is continuously animated to simulate a slow, organic rotation or crawling motion of the ouroboros.
The primary call-to-action text features a character-scramble or glitch effect on initial load, settling into its final state.

design_tokens.type_scale: A single display font is used across all text, with the main 'ENTER' CTA being significantly larger and outlined, and secondary text being smaller and plain.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all interactive elements and the warning box.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, characterized by a large central focus element and ample negative space, creating a sense of isolation and emphasis.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its stark, high-contrast monochrome aesthetic combined with a continuously animating, unsettling central graphic. It eschews traditional navigation and content sections, instead presenting a single, immersive, and slightly ominous interactive gateway that immediately sets a unique mood.
